name: ask
eval: const a=document.querySelector('textarea');a.value='Quelle est la capitale de l\'Espagne ? Un mot.';a.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));document.querySelector('button.send').click(); return true

name: sidebar button toggles the panel
eval: const sb=document.querySelector('.sidebar'); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.topbar button')][0]; const before=sb.classList.contains('collapsed'); b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const mid=sb.classList.contains('collapsed'); const t=document.querySelector('.topbar button'); t.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return [before!==mid, sb.classList.contains('collapsed')===before]

name: settings fit
eval: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.title==='Paramètres'||b.innerText.trim()==='Paramètres').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog').getBoundingClientRect(); return d.width<=innerWidth && d.left>=0
